title.narrative: Evaluation of National Public Education Chile

description.narrative:
As part of the implementation of the New Public Education Law in Chile, the Ministry of Education has entrusted the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and UNESCO Office in Santiago the coordination of an international panel to evaluate the development of this policy.
The committed activities include analyzing those documents that examine the methodology and results of the evaluations carried out in recent years regarding the process of establishing the New Public Education (NPE), with the aim of guiding those participating in this international panel by providing an overview of the main research and evaluations that have analyzed this process over recent years. The objective of this work is to map the findings related to the implementation of this policy.
